claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Marvell 後續文件寫出 Ara T 取消或量產延到 2027 下半年以後；或 OIF、Marvell 產品頁或模組廠一手寫出 TRO 與 LRO 不是同一種架構（例如 TRO 在接收端仍保留部分 DSP 等化）。核查頻率：每半年（Marvell 法說、OFC）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence 或提撤回；若是定義不同，連 tech:lro 的別名與本包其他 supplies_to tech:lro 一起重審。
claims.statement: Marvell press release (2026-03-12): Ara T is 'the first 8x200G transmit-retimed optics (TRO) DSP' (Marvell's self-claim), and 'Marvell Ara X, Ara T, Petra and Aquila M DSPs are sampling to customers beginning in Q1 2026' (qualification stage: sampling). The release says TRO, not LRO; reading TRO as LRO rests on Eoptolink's 2025-03-31 release ('Other names for the same approach are Transmit Retimed Optics (TRO) or Retimed Transmit Linear Receive (RTLR) optics') and OIF's RTLR definition (retimed transmitter, linear receiver) — Marvell itself does not describe the receive side. No customer or production timeline is given.

source_doc.permission_basis: 公司投資人關係網站公開新聞稿；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取頁面 <time datetime="2026-03-12T09:02:00"> 與正文「Released March 12, 2026」。
source_doc.title: Marvell 新聞稿（2026-03-12）〈Marvell Ushers In the 1.6T Era with Expanded Optical DSP Platform Portfolio, Redefining AI Data Center End-to-End Connectivity〉：Ara T 為 8x200G 發送端重定時（TRO）光 DSP，2026 年第一季起送樣

sources.locator: 新產品清單 Ara T 一點（抽字斷行：「Ara T」在上一行，引文自「the first」起）
sources.quote: the first 8x200G transmit-retimed optics (TRO) DSP, delivers improved power efficiency and reduced total cost of ownership in network deployments.
Marvell Ara X, Ara T, Petra and Aquila M DSPs are sampling to customers beginning in Q1 2026.
